svg.data-weight-configured-scope: configured with two fan trays, two RSPs, five fabric cards, and one PEM
svg.data-power-modules-v3: Version 3 power system - up to three AC power modules per system
svg.data-power-ac-input-current: 15 A maximum at 200 VAC; 13 A maximum at 220 to 240 VRMS (UK)
svg.data-power-ac-service-requirement: 20 A North America; 16 A international; 13 A United Kingdom
svg.data-power-ac-redundancy: at least two AC power modules required for N+1 redundancy for a fully configured system
svg.data-power-modules-per-tray-v3: three AC or four DC, one tray
svg.data-power-dc-input-voltage: -48 VDC nominal in North America, -60 VDC in the European Community. Range -40.5 to -72 VDC [-75 VDC for 5 ms] (Table 16). Table 18 gives -40 to -72 VDC
svg.data-power-dc-input-current: 49 A maximum at -48 VDC nominal; 39 A maximum at -60 VDC nominal
svg.data-power-output-bus-voltage: -54.0 VDC nominal, -55.5 VDC maximum, -52.5 VDC minimum (Table 21)
svg.data-power-output-maximum: 18,000 W (three 6000 W AC power modules per tray) or 17,600 W (four 4400 W DC power modules per tray). It is what the power system can support. It is not system power consumption (Table 21)
svg.data-cooling-path: front-to-top-to-rear; inlet at the bottom front, exhaust at the lower rear
svg.data-fan-trays: two, FT0 above FT1, to the right of the card cage

circle.data-description: Input LED. ON continuously when the input voltage is present and within the correct range; BLINKING when the input voltage is out of acceptable range; OFF when no input voltage is present. Cisco states no colour for it.
Output LED. ON when the power module output voltage is present; BLINKING when the power module is in a power limit or overcurrent condition. Cisco states no colour for it.
Fault LED. ON indicates that a power module failure has occurred. Cisco states no colour for it, and gives no off-state sentence.
